scenario.description: At a social gathering, two people meet for the first time and start a conversation, drawn by mutual attraction.

agent_a.name: Miles

profile.personality_and_values: Miles Hawkins, spontaneous and free-spirited, values sanctity and benevolence. He is impulsive and relies on his instincts when making decisions.
profile.public_info: Miles Hawkins, a chef, is a green thumb enthusiast and spends his free time tending to his kitchen garden, using some of his fresh produce in his dishes.

agent_a.goal: Flirt with the other person (<extra_info>Extra information: you are attracted to the other person and want to build a romantic relationship with them</extra_info>)

agent_b.name: Esmeralda

profile.personality_and_values: Esmeralda Solis, known for her creativity and extraversion, values authority and liberty. She makes strategic, decisive decisions.
profile.public_info: Esmeralda Solis is an accomplished District Attorney who has a weakness for ballroom dancing and enjoys practising in her leisure time.

agent_b.goal: Maintain a comfortable yet engaging conversation (<extra_info>Extra information: you are attracted to the other person but you don't want to make them feel uncomfortable or pressured</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Esmeralda Solis aims to maintain a comfortable yet engaging conversation so that she can express her attraction without making the other person feel pressured.
